policy_rules: Gate4 001B remains rejected or critical-risk input only.
Provisional Gate4 001C remains local reference only, not canonical evidence.
Critical-risk earlier Gate2, Gate3, and testbed tasks block Gate4 continuation until repaired or quarantined with replacement evidence under this contract.
If a task is high or critical, future repair must satisfy this canonical contract before downstream use.
If many tasks are high or critical, prefer evidence-harness repair over individual pass-seeking patches.
replacement_evidence_requirement: Replacement evidence must be produced in a new artifact directory and satisfy the computed provenance, fair baseline, real ablation, replay recomputation, leakage positive-control, test failure-path, and mutability contracts.
